recovery_circuit_open.title: Automatic Recovery Circuit Open
recovery_circuit_open.description: Recovery has failed {failures} consecutive times. The next probe is allowed at {nextAttempt}; no valid runtime session is active.

recovery_half_open.title: Recovery Probe In Progress
recovery_half_open.description: The circuit cooldown has elapsed and the current session is verifying whether the data path can recover stably.

recovery_waiting.title: Waiting for Automatic Recovery
recovery_waiting.description: Recovery has failed {failures} consecutive times. The next attempt is allowed at {nextAttempt}.

recovery_ready.title: Waiting for Worker Claim
recovery_ready.description: The recovery backoff has elapsed and the execution is waiting for an available continuous worker.

retention_critical.title: Continuous Recovery Window Critical
retention_critical.description: The committed position may be outside source retention, or the remaining recovery horizon is below the critical threshold.

retention_degraded.title: Continuous Recovery Window at Risk
retention_degraded.description: At the current source growth rate, the estimated recovery horizon is below the degraded threshold.

checkpoint_stalled.title: Target Commit Has Stalled
checkpoint_stalled.description: Source lag remains and the real position commit has not advanced for more than {threshold}.

diagnostics_error.title: Continuous Diagnostics Failed
diagnostics_error.description: Transfer could not complete the latest diagnostics sample: {error}

source_recovery_critical.title: Source Log Recovery Window Lost
source_recovery_critical.description: The capture position is older than the source database's available log boundary, so this capture generation cannot resume continuously from its current position.

source_recovery_unavailable.title: Source Log Recovery Window Unavailable
source_recovery_unavailable.description: Transfer currently lacks the complete facts required to assess the source log recovery window. This does not mean the source is offline.

source_transactions_unavailable.title: Source Transaction Pressure Unavailable
source_transactions_unavailable.description: Transfer cannot currently observe uncommitted transaction pressure. Source recovery and source connectivity remain independent facts.

schema_change_blocked.title: Database Schema Change Blocked Sync
schema_change_blocked.description: The source table schema changed, so the current message and committed position remain unchanged. Approve eligible added fields in the Transfer task, or stop and recreate the task.

collection.waiting: The latest collection succeeded. Some metrics do not yet have valid samples or a complete measurement window.

resources.title: Host monitoring
resources.gaps: Stale, missing and disconnected points appear as gaps.
resources.zoomHint: Drag the slider below the chart to zoom into a period; refresh keeps the current view. Zoom only changes the visible chart. Sample details and period comparisons keep their original scope.
resources.memoryAxes: Left axis: memory capacity ({unit}); right axis: memory usage (%). Total, available memory and usage have separate series; line heights on different scales are not directly comparable. Values below show the last evaluation in the period.
resources.networkBars: Receive and transmit rates of the same interface use grouped bars. Unit: {unit}. Each bar is the average rate over the complete minute before its evaluation, not cumulative traffic. The horizontal axis shows evaluation time. Hover for values; values below show the last evaluation in the period.
resources.pairedThroughput: Compare both directions of the same device. Chart unit: {unit}. Each point is the average rate over the last complete minute, not cumulative traffic. Values below show the last evaluation in the period.
resources.cpuBusyHint: Average non-idle time across cores over the last minute, including I/O wait and steal time; incomplete windows show no data.
resources.tcpSummary: ESTABLISHED + CLOSE_WAIT; excludes listeners and TIME_WAIT.
resources.tcpUnavailable: The current source has no usable host TCP statistics. This does not mean zero connections.

errors.unconfigured: Resource observations are not fully configured.
errors.unavailable: Unable to read resource observations. Refresh later.
errors.timeout: Resource query timed out. Refresh later.
errors.budget: The query exceeds the current budget. Select a shorter range or contact an administrator.
errors.busy: The resource query concurrency limit has been reached. Refresh later.
errors.notFound: This host does not exist or is currently inaccessible.
errors.denied: Your current identity cannot view platform host resources.
errors.invalidResponse: The resource response is incomplete. Refresh to try again.
errors.invalidDimensions: Invalid resource dimensions. Return to the host list to select a resource.

filesystem.title: Filesystem mounts
filesystem.hint: Capacity by mount. Bind mounts, memory and network filesystems are not summed as physical capacity.
filesystem.empty: Filesystem collection succeeded, but no usable mount data is available.
filesystem.notCollected: The current source does not provide filesystem metrics.
filesystem.collectorFailed: Filesystem collection failed. Check source permissions and runtime status.
filesystem.unknown: No filesystem data. Collection coverage has not been confirmed.

resources.loadSummary: Average number of running or waiting tasks, not a percentage.
resources.loadHint: Tasks are processes or threads that are running, waiting for CPU, or in uninterruptible wait (often I/O). The 1, 5 and 15 minute values are smoothed averages, so decimals are normal. Interpret them alongside CPU utilization; dividing by core count does not give CPU utilization.

disk.title: Disk IO
disk.orderHint: Devices with IO activity appear first; idle devices are collapsed by default. Missing or stale data remains visible.
disk.allIdle: No devices currently have IO activity. Expand to view all devices.

diskRead.detail: Average data read per second over the last complete minute, per device. Devices are not summed; incomplete windows or counter resets remain missing.

diskWrite.detail: Average data written per second over the last complete minute, per device. Devices are not summed; incomplete windows or counter resets remain missing.

diskBusy.detail: Percentage of the last complete minute during which the device had IO requests in progress. This alone does not prove saturation; interpret it alongside throughput and duration. Incomplete windows or counter resets remain missing.

diskReadDuration.detail: Average time per completed read request over the last complete minute, including queueing and processing. No completed reads, incomplete windows or counter resets display “—”, not 0 ms.

diskWriteDuration.detail: Average time per completed write request over the last complete minute, including queueing and processing. No completed writes, incomplete windows or counter resets display “—”, not 0 ms.

disk.empty: No disk throughput data. A continuous one-minute counter window is required. Check for interrupted collection, missing samples or counter reset.
disk.unknown: No disk throughput data. The cause is unconfirmed; check disk collection and a continuous one-minute counter window.

network.title: Network interface throughput
network.hint: Average receive and transmit rates over a full minute, per interface. Bridges, virtual and loopback interfaces are not summed; rates do not indicate link utilization.
network.empty: No network throughput data. Interface collection succeeded, but no valid rate samples are available. A continuous one-minute counter window is required; missing samples, reboot or counter reset can also prevent calculation.
network.notCollected: The current source does not provide network interface metrics. Waiting will not produce throughput data.
network.collectorFailed: Network interface collection failed. Check source permissions and runtime status.
network.unknown: No network throughput data. Interface collection coverage has not been confirmed.

overview.budget: This page exceeds the resource query budget. Reduce the page size or ask an administrator to adjust the budget.

comparison.title: Period comparison
comparison.enable: Compare with the previous equal period
comparison.incomplete: Insufficient samples. Both periods must be complete to show averages and change.
comparison.increased: Up {value} percentage points from the previous period
comparison.decreased: Down {value} percentage points from the previous period
comparison.smallChange: Change from the previous period is less than 0.01 percentage points
comparison.method: Calculated from curve evaluation points, evaluated every {step} seconds. Complete evaluation points do not prove lossless raw sampling.
comparison.cpuWindow: Each CPU point covers the preceding minute and may include data before the period began.
comparison.retention: Comparing 7-day periods needs about 14 days of history, beyond current retention. The 7-day curve remains available.

history.fixed: Historical trend ending at {time}. Refresh keeps this time fixed. Resource cards above still show current values. Retention and the current source constrain the curve; missing samples remain gaps.
history.invalid: The historical end time is invalid or later than the current server query time.

block.title: Disk and volume capacity
block.hint: Capacity per visible device. Mapped volumes and underlying devices cannot be added; this is not a physical host total.
block.scope: Docker Desktop shows its Linux VM view, not Mac physical disks or total Docker volume capacity.
block.failed: Device capacity collection failed or evidence is incomplete
block.unsupported: The device capacity view cannot be verified on this node

process.title: Service monitoring
process.hostNameHint: Exact match on the declared host name or process runtime hostname, ignoring case; not the display name in host management.
process.hostIPHint: Enter the IPv4 or IPv6 of the host running the instance, without a port or subnet; separate from the registered service address.
process.invalidQuery: Invalid query conditions. Check the filter values.
process.addressHint: Enter the service endpoint hostname or IP, without protocol or port.

comparison.smallMemoryChange: Change from the previous period is less than 0.01 B
comparison.smallCPUChange: Change from the previous period is less than 0.01 cores
comparison.cpuWindow: Each CPU point is average core usage over the preceding full minute, not a percentage.
comparison.launch: Both periods must be after this process started and have complete evaluation points. History before launch and warm-up data are excluded.

trend.title: Service process trends
trend.scope: CPU and memory since this process started. CPU shows one-minute average core usage; missing valid samples remain gaps.
trend.zoomHint: Drag the slider below the chart to focus on a time range.
trend.reselect: The selected instance is offline, collection is not enabled, or it is outside the current page. Select an instance from the list.

process.declarationHint: Enabled does not mean collection succeeded. Check collection status.

hints.cpu: 1 core ≈ one fully occupied logical core; can exceed 1
hints.uptime: Elapsed time since this process started

process.waiting: Waiting for a complete minute of valid samples
process.denied: The current identity cannot view service monitoring.
process.notFound: The service instance was removed. Refresh the list.

evidence.title: Resource alert details
evidence.frozen: These conditions and values were saved when the alert opened. Later rule changes do not alter this evidence.
evidence.unavailable: Complete trigger evidence is unavailable; historical conditions cannot be displayed.
evidence.hostUnavailable: This host cannot currently be read. Resource monitoring is unavailable.

resourceRules.noMatching: No capacity rule for this mount
resourceRules.invalidFilter: The mount rule filter is incomplete or invalid. Return to the host and select the mount again.
resourceRules.saved: Rule saved. New rules are disabled by default.
resourceRules.title: Resource rules
resourceRules.triggerHint: All consecutive valid samples must exceed the threshold; equality does not trigger an alert.
resourceRules.recoveryHint: Recovery must be greater than 0 and lower than the trigger. Active alerts keep the recovery policy saved when opened. Missing data never means recovery.
resourceRules.disabledHint: New rules are saved disabled. Review the settings, then edit to enable.
resourceRules.invalid: Enter a name and use 0 < recovery < trigger ≤ 100. Durations must be 15–300 seconds in multiples of 15.
resourceRules.conflict: The rule changed or a rule already exists for this resource. Your input is retained. Close and refresh the rule list to review.
resourceRules.deleteHint: Delete “{name}”? Active alerts must meet their recovery conditions first. Alert history is retained.
resourceRules.deleteConflict: The rule changed or still has an active alert. Refresh to review; edit and disable it to pause evaluation.

reasons.no_data: Valid samples missing; check host collection
reasons.source_changed: Host, collection configuration or query budget changed; rebuilding the window
reasons.collection_paused: Host or collection target is disabled
reasons.identity_unavailable: Host and source identities could not be verified
reasons.query_unavailable: Resource query failed; check the collection pipeline
reasons.mount_missing: The selected mount is not currently observed

resourceRules.noMounts: No currently valid filesystem observation is available for this host.
resourceRules.filesystemHint: This exact mount is fixed after creation. Missing or permanently removed mounts do not resolve existing alerts.
resourceRules.mountRequired: Select a currently observed filesystem mount.

http.title: HTTP quality
http.boundary: Platform operations own shared HTTP quality. Ingress and backend request rates are separate and must not be added into a global QPS.
http.noInterfaces: No route samples with a complete window
http.samples: The top 10 eligible templates by the selected metric. Missing samples remain unavailable; new templates need a complete window.

httpRules.title: HTTP quality rules
httpRules.scope: Rules cover all current instances of the selected module and runtime layer. New rules start disabled.
httpRules.subject: Module and interface scope
httpRules.anchorHint: The instance verifies the module and runtime layer. The rule follows current instances of that module.
httpRules.template: Framework template such as /items/:id; empty means unmatched requests
httpRules.policyHint: Thresholds use the metric unit. Enabling restarts the observation window. Active alerts retain their opening recovery policy; disabling does not resolve them.
httpRules.invalid: Enter a name, valid template, 0 < recovery < trigger, and durations of 15–300 seconds in multiples of 15.
httpRules.conflict: The rule version changed or this interface scope already has the same metric rule. Your draft is retained; close and refresh to review.

traces.title: Traces
traces.coverage: Sampled, retained HTTP traces and execution stages are shown. Empty results may reflect sampling, unfinished stages, expiration or collection loss. Policy definition version: 2.
traces.relationshipHint: Only matched Client and Server spans establish a call. Missing edges do not establish the absence of dependencies.
traces.empty: No readable retained traces match this query
traces.invalid: Use a valid instance, Trace ID and a time range of up to one hour
traces.failed: Trace query failed; try again later

engines.title: Engine monitoring
engines.denied: This account cannot read platform engine monitoring
engines.name: Engine deployment
engines.missing: No valid value yet; collection startup, insufficient samples or statistics resets leave gaps.
engines.trendScope: Current database container only, up to seven days. Restarts, statistics resets and missing samples may leave gaps.

hints.total: Client connections excluding this observation session.
hints.idle: Connections outside a transaction with no running query.
hints.idleTransaction: Connections inside an open transaction with no running query.
hints.waiting: Active client connections waiting on an event.
hints.lockWaiting: Active connections waiting for a database lock.
hints.maximum: Configured connection limit, including reserved slots.
hints.committed: Full one-minute commit rate, including observation traffic; not business throughput.
hints.rolledBack: Full one-minute rollback rate; not directly a count of business failures.
hints.deadlocks: Full one-minute deadlock rate; missing or reset statistics are not zero-filled.
hints.capacity: Total size of non-template databases, without tenant attribution.

processRules.title: Service instance resource rules
processRules.scope: Evaluate CPU and RSS per running instance. Exit, offline state and missing samples do not resolve alerts. Configure a new rule after a process restart.
processRules.subject: Service instance
processRules.anchorHint: Select a current instance with declared metrics. The instance and metric are immutable.
processRules.policyHint: New rules start disabled. Save conditions before enabling. Active alerts keep their original recovery conditions.
processRules.cpuHint: Unit: cores. For example, 1.5 means an average of 1.5 logical cores, not a percentage.
processRules.memoryHint: Unit: GiB. Resident memory pressure does not establish a memory leak.
processRules.invalid: Enter a name and positive thresholds. Recovery must be below trigger; durations must be 15–300 seconds in steps of 15.
processRules.conflict: Rule conflict, duplicate metric, or changed instance identity. Input is preserved; close and refresh to review.

container.title: Container and cgroup usage
container.scope: Usage covers the whole cgroup, including helper processes. It differs from the individual process CPU and RSS.
container.verified: Container identity and the complete limit hierarchy are verified. Hard upper bounds are not exclusive or guaranteed capacity.
container.unverified: No valid container proof. Only absolute usage of this process cgroup is shown. Native macOS and sources without cgroup sampling have no cgroup data.
container.proofTime: Limits verified at {value}; utilization is evaluated at that instant.
container.noProof: Container identity or complete ancestor limits cannot be verified; utilization is unavailable.
container.noLimit: No finite verified hard upper bound; utilization is unavailable.
container.window: Stable limit evidence does not yet cover the complete CPU window.

hints.cpu: CPU time increase over one minute, expressed in logical cores.
hints.memory: cgroup memory.current includes caches and is not process RSS.
hints.cpuRatio: Cgroup CPU core usage divided by the verified CPU bound; not host CPU utilization.
hints.memoryRatio: Whole cgroup memory divided by its verified hard bound; not process RSS utilization.

container.notConnected: Cgroup sampling is not connected. Native macOS does not provide it; process CPU and RSS trends remain available below.

availability.title: Service availability rules
availability.recovery: At least one replica online for {seconds} seconds
availability.scope: A group shares a module, role and purpose; any valid online replica makes the group online.
availability.enableHint: New rules start disabled. Each enabled intent must first be observed running; initial waiting does not trigger a disconnection alert.
availability.invalid: Enter a name, select a group, and set durations from 15 to 300 seconds in steps of 15.

reasons.waiting_confirmation: No valid online replica has been confirmed for this intent
reasons.source_changed: Intent or observations changed; awaiting verification
reasons.identity_unavailable: Current service group facts are unavailable
reasons.observation_not_advanced: Observation did not advance; timing restarted

availability.conflict: The rule version changed or this service group already has a rule. Your draft is retained; close and refresh before retrying.
